item.title: At the café
item.description: Words you need to order food and drinks and pay in a café.

children.definition: a list of the food and drinks in a café or restaurant
children.example: Can I see the menu, please?

children.definition: to ask for food or drink in a café or restaurant
children.example: I'd like to order a coffee and a sandwich.

children.definition: a person who brings food and drinks to your table
children.example: The waiter brought our soup very quickly.

children.definition: a small tool with a round end that you use to eat soup or stir tea
children.example: Can I have a spoon for my soup, please?

children.definition: a small round container with a handle, for hot drinks
children.example: A cup of black tea, please.

children.definition: a container you can see through, for cold drinks
children.example: Can I have a glass of water?

children.definition: a flat round dish that you put food on
children.example: There are two somsa on my plate.

children.definition: a sweet white or brown food that you put in drinks
children.example: Do you take sugar in your coffee?

children.definition: a hot brown drink made from roasted beans
children.example: I drink coffee every morning before work.

children.definition: a hot liquid food made with vegetables or meat
children.example: The lentil soup here is very good.

children.definition: a cold dish of mixed vegetables, for example tomatoes and cucumbers
children.example: I'll have a salad and some bread, please.

children.definition: two pieces of bread with cheese, meat or vegetables between them
children.example: She eats a chicken sandwich for lunch.
